Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.InteractAsync(engine, url, new List<PageAction>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PageAction>("{\"selector\":\"#open\",\"type\":\"click\"}", ConfigOptions)!, JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PageAction>("{\"selector\":\"#field\",\"text\":\"test_data\",\"type\":\"type\"}", ConfigOptions)!, JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PageAction>("{\"selector\":\"#submit\",\"type\":\"click\"}", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].ActionIndex);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].ActionType);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].Success);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[1].ActionIndex);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[1].ActionType);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[1].Success);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[2].ActionIndex);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[2].ActionType);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[2].Success);
```
